column1: Note: Includes the largest jails in 45 states and the District of Columbia and jail jurisdictions with an average daily population of 1,000 or more inmates. Excludes data for five states with combined prison-and-jail systems: Connecticut, Delaware, Hawaii, Rhode Island, and Vermont. Includes large jail data for Alaska though it also operates a combined prison-and-jail system. See Terms and definitions for information on types of victimization.
a/An accurate average daily population was unavailable. The population from the Mortality in Correctional Institutions was used.
b/Allegations of abusive sexual contact could not be counted separately from allegations of nonconsensual sexual acts.
c/Allegations of staff sexual harassment could not be counted separately from allegations of staff sexual misconduct.
d/Allegations of staff sexual harassment were not recorded.
e/Allegations of abusive sexual contact were not recorded.
f/Counts of nonconsensual sexual acts were based on completed acts only.
g/Only substantiated incidents of nonconsensual sexual acts were recorded.
